title: DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS
summary: The player needs D3D11 video interfaces D3DMetal lacks, and the decoded frame carried across to its D3D12 renderer.

excerpts.note: The D3D12 renderer opens the handle of a frame decoded on the D3D11 device; the bridge answers with a texture on the game's own device that carries the frame across.
On the D3D11 side IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle returns E_NOTIMPL; the bridge hands out a handle of its own that the D3D12 side recognises.

symptom: Cutscenes play with sound and subtitles, and a black picture.
cause: The cutscenes are WebM (VP9) decoded by IMFSourceReader on a separate D3D11 device and presented by a D3D12 renderer: the frame never reaches the renderer, and a stock CrossOver 26.3 ships no demuxer that opens a WebM.
fix: A bridge in libxess.dll answers the shared handle of each decoded frame and carries it across to the D3D12 renderer. On CrossOver Preview 27 that is all it needs.
